evidence.label: TMP102 supply-current allowance
evidence.detail: 100 uA is an authored allowance, not a manufacturer peak-current specification. SBOS397I page 5 gives mode-dependent average currents: 7.5 uA maximum with an inactive bus at the default rate, and 40 uA typical at a 2.85 MHz active bus. Output pull-up currents and transient peaks need separate review.
